children: Ultimate Race Fans Mixers will host around 250 Formula 1 enthusiasts each in Mumbai, Gurgaon and Kolkata on 26 September
Heineken 0.0 is set to bring Formula 1 (F1) fans together across Mumbai, Gurgaon and Kolkata through its Ultimate Race Fans Mixers on 26 September.

The initiative will create dedicated spaces for fans to watch the Qatar Airways Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2026 while participating in interactive games, prediction challenges and other fan activities. The format is designed to extend the race-day experience beyond the screen and encourage fans to connect with others who share an interest in the sport.

The three events will take place simultaneously on Saturday, 26 September, at Ajmera IndiKarting in Mumbai, Five Mad Men in Kolkata and Underdoggs Arena in Gurugram. Each venue is expected to accommodate around 250 F1 fans, taking the combined expected audience across the three cities to approximately 750 people.
The Mumbai edition will also feature actor Arjun Kapoor, who will join fans for the race-day experience.

Alongside live screenings of the race, the events will include interactive games, prediction challenges and social activities. The initiative is centred on creating opportunities for fans to interact and engage with the sport collectively.

Vikram Bahl, Chief Marketing Officer, United Breweries Limited, said Formula 1 has the ability to bring together people who may not otherwise meet through their shared passion for the sport. He added that the Ultimate Race Fans Mixers are intended to take this connection beyond the screen and create opportunities for fan interaction around race-day excitement.
The initiative extends Heineken 0.0's association with Formula 1 into a social and community-led experience, positioning race weekends as opportunities for fans to connect in person.

The Ultimate Race Fans Mixers will culminate in a finale in Bengaluru on 18 October 2026. The finale is planned as Heineken 0.0's flagship fan experience for the season and is expected to feature an in-person appearance by a globally renowned Formula 1 driver.
Further details about the Bengaluru venue and finale are expected to be announced closer to the event.
